concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished high fidelity desktop web application screenshot, landscape 16:10, edge-to-edge flat screen, crisp readable typography, no device frame, no perspective, no collage. This is the actual logged-in EdTrack ONE institution demo dashboard, NOT a homepage or marketing website. It should impress investors through clarity and craft. Inspired by Lintel's generous spacing, pill-shaped horizontal navigation, finely weighted typography, sophisticated large panels and minimal controls, but create an original education platform.
Consistent UI content: top left wordmark "EdTrack ONE"; institution switcher "Demo Institute"; top right small "DEMO · SAMPLE DATA" badge, search icon, notification icon and user avatar initials. Horizontal primary navigation: Overview (active), Students, Learning, Fees, Compliance. Main heading "Your campus, connected." with small subtitle "Monday, 2 November · Institution overview". Primary button "Enrol student".
A restrained row of four metrics: "Active learners" 248, "Enrolments this month" 36, "Fees collected" A$84,600, "Assessments to review" 18. Below, large left enrolment-trend panel with clearly plotted six-month chart Jun–Nov and a compact "6 months" control. Right panel "Needs attention" with three actionable rows: "12 applications ready for review", "8 invoices due this week", "18 assessments awaiting feedback". Lower left "Learner journey" as a beautifully readable connected horizontal progression Enquiry 64 → Enrolled 36 → Learning 248 → Completed 24. Lower right "Today's schedule" with "09:30 · Nursing fundamentals", "11:00 · Admissions review", "14:00 · Trainer check-in". Small bottom line "Demo environment · All figures are sample data". Airy layout with substantial white space, refined icons, consistent alignment, believable usable dashboard. Make every element functional-looking and legible. No invented product claims, compliance guarantees or customer/adoption claims. No decorative 3D objects. No design explanation or motion annotations inside screenshot.
Visual direction: NEUMORPHISM / soft precision. Very pale cool grey sculpted interface, softly extruded monochrome panels, delicate paired white upper-left and grey lower-right shadows, inset selected navigation and inset chart track, tactile controls. Dark graphite text with excellent contrast, focused cobalt blue data accent, muted mint status. Use soft depth selectively so data remains precise. Minimal premium calm, not puffy toy UI.

Visual direction: MODERN RETRO / warm intelligence. Warm ivory paper surface, muted burnt orange, olive green, buttery yellow, dark espresso ink. Restrained 1970s Swiss-computing influence, elegant rounded geometric headline type, simple modern sans data labels and monospaced microcopy. Visual direction: BAUHAUS / structured energy. Functional Bauhaus modernism adapted to a beautiful minimal SaaS dashboard. Bone-white ground, geometric typography, near-black text, disciplined asymmetric grid. Controlled primary vermilion, cobalt blue and golden yellow accents. Design must read as real sophisticated admin software, not a Bauhaus poster.

Visual direction: COHESIVE HYBRID OF ALL SIX / connected calm. Synthesize all six approaches with editorial hierarchy as the foundation: warm pearl canvas, elegant serif main heading, crisp sans-serif controls, generous asymmetric grid and fine rules. Subtle neumorphic tactile search and primary controls; translucent frosted glass top navigation; modern retro muted rust and sage; brutalist confident black CTA with tiny hard offset edge; Bauhaus geometric cobalt, ochre and vermilion micro accents integrated ONLY into learner journey data markers; editorial typographic restraint. Chart cobalt, main text ink. This must feel like ONE tightly art-directed premium product, not six competing themes. Surfaces understated and mostly white, low visual noise, sharp hierarchy, tactile micro details.
